blocks.text: CALOOCAN CITY, Philippines — Public prosecutors indicted the teller and the registered operator of an authorized lotto outlet in Caloocan before the Regional Trial Court (RTC) in Caloocan on Monday, Nov. 9. The case stemmed from the teller’s arrest last week for using a legitimate government franchise to run an underground numbers game. The Caloocan City Prosecutor’s Office charged the outlet’s teller with violating Presidential Decree No. 1602, as amended by Section 3(b) of Republic Act No. 9287, which penalizes illegal numbers games.
